title: 第1章 天生凡体第2章 就算你爹是大帝也不能这么嚣张
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: “我没死？”
李轩睁开双眼，只感觉头痛欲裂。
他本是仙界帝族少主，爹无敌，娘无敌，家世背景无敌。
可就是由于这种无敌的家世背景，造就了他狂妄跋扈的性格。
就在刚才，他那大帝老爹终于是对他忍无可忍，在将他逐出帝族之后，还一脚踹下了仙界。
“快看，那里有个人。”
“玛德，抢生意的？干他！”
“看他身上的衣服不错，扒了！”
就在这时，三道声音忽然传来，然后李轩就看到三个乞丐模样的中年一脸凶神恶煞的朝他扑了过来。
“滚开！”
李轩眼神一冷。
这时他才发现自己正身处一垃圾堆旁，浑身都脏兮兮的，身上也是充满了臭味。
他顾不得恶心，起身就打算先干倒那三个家伙。
可就在这时，他却惊骇的发现自己竟然已经实力全无，体内也没有了半点仙气。
“修为，消失了？”
李轩大惊，而就在这时，那三个家伙已经如同饿虎扑食一般冲了过来。
李轩想也没想，抬腿就闪电般三脚踹了过去。
三道沉闷的声响，三人腹部吃痛，惨叫着跌飞。
李轩也是不由后退了两步，差点趔趄摔倒。
他心中无奈，自己现在都弱到如此地步，打三个普通人都这般费劲了吗？
那三人则是满脸惊骇看着李轩，爬起来后二话不说转身便跑。
李轩没有理会三人，而是赶紧查看起了自己的身体。
片刻后，他松了口气。
他身体没有任何问题，只是失去了修为。
李轩苦涩一笑。
没有了修为，那岂不是意味着凡人一个？
帝族少主，凡人一个，这种反差，还当真是令人难以接受。
“咦，竟然是传说中的天生凡体？小子，你运气不错，遇到鼎爷是你的福气。你放心，有鼎爷在，你必定会登临绝巅，走上无敌。”
正当李轩打算运转家族功法，尝试修炼之时，一道声音忽然传来，李轩一惊，“谁？”
“小子，不要那么大惊小怪，你身为未来大帝，终要走向无敌的至高存在，要沉得住气。”
那道声音再次传来，李轩这次看清楚了，声音来源竟然是自己胸口位置。
他赶忙低头看了一下，只见那里有着一个黑色小鼎印记。
content_en:
"I'm not dead?"
Li Xuan opened his eyes and felt a splitting headache.
He was originally the young master of the imperial clan in the immortal world. His father was invincible, his mother was invincible, and his family background was invincible.
But it is because of this invincible family background that he has created his arrogant and domineering character.
Just now, his great emperor father finally had enough patience with him. After expelling him from the imperial clan, he even kicked him down to the fairy world.
"Look, there's someone there."
"Made, a business thief? Fuck him!"
"Look at the clothes he's wearing, take them off!"
At this moment, three voices suddenly came, and then Li Xuan saw three middle-aged men who looked like beggars rushing towards him with fierce expressions.
"Get away!"
Li Xuan's eyes turned cold.
Only then did he realize that he was standing next to a garbage dump, his whole body was dirty and full of stench.
Regardless of his nausea, he stood up and planned to kill the three guys first.
But at this moment, he was shocked to find that he had no strength at all, and there was no trace of immortal energy in his body.
"Cultivation has disappeared?"
Li Xuan was shocked, and at this moment, the three guys rushed over like hungry tigers.
Without thinking, Li Xuan raised his leg and kicked him three times like lightning.
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
There were three dull sounds, and the three of them felt pain in their abdomens and fell down screaming.
Li Xuan couldn't help but take two steps back and almost stumbled.
He felt helpless. He was so weak now. Was it so difficult to beat three ordinary people?
The three people looked at Li Xuan with horror on their faces, got up, turned around and ran away without saying a word.
Li Xuan ignored the three people and quickly checked his body.
After a moment, he breathed a sigh of relief.
There is nothing wrong with his body, he just lost his cultivation.
"This..."
Li Xuan smiled bitterly.
Without cultivation, doesn’t that mean that he is just a mortal?
The young master of the Imperial Clan is a mortal. This kind of contrast is really unacceptable.
"Hey, it turned out to be the legendary born mortal body? Boy, you are lucky. You are lucky to meet Master Ding. Don't worry, with Master Ding here, you will definitely reach the top and become invincible."
Just when Li Xuan was planning to run the family's skills and try to practice, a voice suddenly came, and Li Xuan was startled, "Who?"
"Boy, don't make such a fuss. As the future emperor, you will eventually move towards the invincible supreme existence, so you must stay calm."
The sound came again, and Li Xuan saw clearly this time that the source of the sound turned out to be his chest.
He quickly looked down and saw a small black cauldron mark there.
title_en: Chapter 1 Born with Mortal Body Chapter 2 Even if your father is the Great Emperor, he can’t be so arrogant
